Updates.
hero.subtitle: Tracking the continuous improvement of the SafeTools local-first engine and studio suite.

data.title: The Modular Era
data.desc: A complete architectural overhaul of the localization engine, enabling granular, feature-specific asset loading for maximum performance.

highlights.text: Modular i18n framework with feature-level namespace isolation.
Enhanced Zero-Server integrity for all cryptographic tools.
Hardened LSB mutation engine for image steganography.

data.title: WASM Engine v2
data.desc: Upgraded the core processing engine with multi-threaded WebAssembly support for near-native file processing speeds.

highlights.text: Advanced Metadata Scrubber with batch processing support.
Optimized FFmpeg WASM loading times by 40%.
Resolved memory leaks in heavy image conversion jobs.

data.title: Security Hardening
data.desc: Focusing on the absolute privacy of user data with enhanced security headers and sandboxed execution environments.

highlights.text: Industrial-grade File Shredder with multi-pass overwrite.
Refined Privacy Manifesto and verification guide.
